title: Chapter 370 Base
content:
Chapter 370 Base

The surrounding scene changed, and Wang Shuo appeared in a gourd-shaped valley.

There were broken walls and ruins all around, with a dilapidated altar in the middle.

[Use your Shura Order to activate the base. ]

Wang Shuo heard the prompt, walked over, and took out his Shura Order.

The damaged altar immediately began to repair, and then a small stone pillar rose.

Wang Shuo had seen this kind of small stone pillar many times.

He put his hand on it and immediately felt a lot of information.

This stone pillar is called the base stone, which is similar to the core of the territory.

You can summon generals from it.

Killing creatures in neutral and hostile camps can gain merit points.

And merit points are the currency for exchanging materials and generals from the base stone.

Using 10 Shura Orders can upgrade the base stone to level 2.

Moreover, the Shura Order can also be directly exchanged for generals from the base stone.

A level 1 base can summon 1 primary general with 100 merit points, up to 10.

A level 2 base can summon 1 intermediate general with 1,000 merit points, up to 20 junior generals, 10 intermediate generals, and can also summon an additional general with the Shura Order.

Wang Shuo was ecstatic when he got this information.

He brought 50 Shura Orders from the first-level General Tower, which just came in handy.

Without hesitation, Wang Shuo directly consumed 10 Shura Orders and upgraded the base to level 2.

At this time, the prompt for upgrading to level 3 appeared, requiring 40 Shura Orders.

His own Shura Order could not be used and had to be carried with him.

At this time, he only had 39 extra Shura Orders.

At present, he had no merit points and could not exchange for generals, so he could only exchange for a general first.

A stream of light turned, and a tall general appeared in front of Wang Shuo.

"Your subordinate Zhu Tianguo, see the master."

"Well, very good!" Wang Shuo checked and found that this person's combat power was not inferior to his own.

"Do you know what's going on around here?" Wang Shuo asked casually, wanting to know how different the generals or warriors summoned here are from the tools.

"My Lord, I don't know, but if you give me an order, I will find out as soon as possible."

Wang Shuo nodded. It seemed that he still needed to figure out many things.

For example, what are the conditions for passing this level?

He checked the base stone again.

This time he found some relevant information.

At present, this canyon is located within the territory of the Earth Mother Zerg Clan. His camp is the purple camp, and there is another hostile camp, the red camp.

Both camps are human, and the Earth Mother Zerg Clan is a third force.

It can be said that all three parties are enemies.

The condition for Wang Shuo's camp to win is to eliminate all the living forces of the enemy camp.

Wang Shuo checked the forces of his camp.

There are a total of 100 green dots distributed around him.

It seems that there should be 100 people in the hostile camp.

After Wang Shuo understood the general situation, he took his men to investigate the terrain nearby.

There was no danger in the gourd terrain, and there were even some walls built before on the edge.

But they were basically destroyed.

It can be seen that this area should be the scope of the base.

Outside the gourd terrain, there is a vast hilly area, and Wang Shuo soon found a large number of earth mother insects.

They look a bit like spiders, but they don’t have the huge abdomen of spiders, and they emit a light blue light all over their bodies.

Wang Shuo signaled Zhu Tianguo to go and kill one to see what effect it would have.
